features.name: Order book commands
features.description: Send limit and market orders, cancels, reduces and replaces to a single-instrument price-time priority book.
features.inputs: A Command (Limit, Market, Cancel, Reduce or Replace)
features.outputs: Events appended to a caller-owned Vec<Event>: accepted, trades, fills, cancels, reductions, replacements, rejections

features.name: Order book queries
features.description: Read the best bid and ask, depth per level, a full snapshot, one resting order and the order with time priority.
features.command: matching_engine::OrderBook::{best_bid, best_ask, depth, snapshot, order, front_order}
features.inputs: A side or an order id
features.outputs: Prices, LevelDepth list, Snapshot, OrderInfo or an order id

features.name: Book invariant check
features.description: Check that the book is not crossed and that its levels, queues and id map agree.
features.outputs: Ok, or an error message naming the broken invariant

features.name: ITCH 5.0 parser
features.description: Split length-prefixed ITCH 5.0 frames and decode each message without allocating.
features.outputs: Message values, or an ItchError for a truncated, empty, unknown, wrong-length or invalid message

features.name: ITCH replay driver
features.description: Drive one order book per stock locate from ITCH messages, replaying executions as aggressor orders.
features.inputs: Decoded ITCH messages in stream order
features.outputs: The command and events of each message, per-book state and the replay counters (Stats)

features.name: Golden replay check
features.description: Replay a whole ITCH day, print the summary counts and the replay hash, and record or check them against a golden file.
features.command: cargo run --release --example replay -- [--write GOLDEN | --check GOLDEN] [--limit N] [--diagnose] FILE
features.inputs: An ITCH 5.0 file, optionally a golden file
features.outputs: Summary lines and the replay hash on stdout; with --check, exit status 1 and the differing lines on any difference

features.name: Differential replay against the reference book
features.description: Replay the book commands of chosen symbols through the real book and the slow reference book and compare every event.
features.command: cargo run --release --example diff_slice -- [--symbols A,B,...] [--limit N] [--snapshot-every K] FILE
features.outputs: A per-book report; exit status 1 with the command and both event lists on the first difference

features.name: Latency and throughput benchmark
features.description: Time every message of the ITCH day through the replay and measure throughput, as one JSON line per run.
features.command: cargo run --release --example bench -- [--limit N] [--window HH:MM:SS-HH:MM:SS] [--commit LABEL] [--no-throughput] [--allow-non-linux] FILE
features.outputs: One JSON line with latency percentiles, throughput, timer cost and host readings

features.name: Repeated benchmark runs
features.description: Run the benchmark several times pinned to one CPU and summarise the runs.
features.outputs: One JSON line per run and a summary JSON line on stdout; a table on stderr

features.name: Microbenchmarks of the book's parts
features.description: Time one part of the book (side, level, orders, book or parse) on a workload derived from the real day.
features.command: cargo run --release --features internals --example micro -- side|level|orders|book|parse [--passes N] [--commit LABEL] [--allow-non-linux] FILE
features.inputs: A part name and an ITCH 5.0 file; a workload cache in micro-cache/ beside the file
features.outputs: One JSON line with ns per operation, operation and allocation counts and the workload checksum

features.name: Keep benchmark binaries
features.description: Build the release benchmark and microbenchmarks for the current checkout and keep copies for later comparisons.
features.outputs: $BENCH_BINS/LABEL/bench and micro with commit.txt, build.txt and settings.txt

features.name: Compare two builds
features.description: Run a baseline and a candidate binary in alternating pairs and give a verdict on one declared statistic.
features.command: scripts/compare.sh [-s STAT] [-n PAIRS] [-c CPU] [-l LIMIT] [-t] [-w WINDOW] [-m PART] [-f FLOOR] BASELINE CANDIDATE [FILE]
features.inputs: Two bench or micro binaries and an ITCH 5.0 file
features.outputs: Run lines, per-pair differences and a summary line with the verdict on stdout; tables on stderr

features.name: Comparison summary
features.description: Recompute a comparison's effects, intervals and verdict from its saved run lines.
features.inputs: A file of compare.sh run lines with one metadata or summary line
features.outputs: Per-pair difference lines and a summary line on stdout; tables on stderr; exit status 2 on a refusal

features.name: Fetch the ITCH sample day
features.description: Download, verify and decompress the public Nasdaq TotalView-ITCH 5.0 sample for 30 December 2019.
features.outputs: 12302019.NASDAQ_ITCH50.gz and the decompressed file, checked against the pinned size and SHA-256

features.name: Benchmark commit label
features.description: Print the checkout's commit as a benchmark label, with -dirty for uncommitted tracked changes.
features.outputs: The full commit SHA, optionally with -dirty, or unknown

features.name: Benchmark comparisons on Kaggle
features.description: Validate a plan of comparisons, package it as a Kaggle kernel and run it on a Kaggle CPU session.
features.command: python3 scripts/kaggle_bench.py --write-kernel PLAN DIR [--owner NAME] | --dry-run PLAN | --self-test
features.inputs: A plan in scripts/kaggle-plans/ and the git branches it names
features.outputs: Dataset and kernel folders to upload; on Kaggle, results/ with per-step output, STATUS.json and SUMMARY.md
